headline: Iran Says Three Tankers Struck Mines in Eastern Strait of Hormuz
deck: Iran Dossier reported that an outbound tanker was hit near Khasab in a UKMTO warning.
body: On Wednesday, Iran’s army said three oil tankers struck naval mines, caught fire and were unable to sail in the eastern Strait of Hormuz. In a statement, it said the vessels had switched off their navigation systems before entering an area it described as off-limits to shipping. [E2][E3]

On 18 November, this paper reported that the United States had carried out several attacks on Qeshm Island hours after Iran said it launched a drone attack on a U.S. radar system in Bahrain. Iran Dossier reported that UKMTO recorded two warnings about incidents north of Khasab. [E5][E1][E4]

At 16:45 UTC on 18 November, Iran Dossier reported that UKMTO recorded Warning 212-26 after an outbound tanker was hit in its engine room by an unknown projectile six nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman; it said the crew was safe and the damage and environmental impact were not known. Iran Dossier said Warning 211-26 concerned another incident 13 nautical miles north of Khasab. [E4]
